info.title: Libredesk API
info.description:
REST API documentation for Libredesk helpdesk system.

## Authentication

The Libredesk API supports two authentication methods:

### 1. Basic Authentication
Use your API key and secret with Basic authentication:
```
Authorization: Basic <base64_encoded_api_key:api_secret>
```

### 2. Token Authentication  
Use your API key and secret with token authentication:
```
Authorization: token api_key:api_secret
```

To obtain API credentials, generate them from your agent profile in the Libredesk dashboard.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON-encoded filter. Either an array of conditions that are AND-ed, e.g. `[{"model":"conversations","field":"status_id","operator":"equals","value":"1"}]`, or a group `{"logic":"AND","rules":[...]}` with at most one level of nested groups. Operators: `equals`, `not equals`, `greater than`, `less than`, `set`, `not set`, `in`, `between`, `contains`, `ilike`, `not contains`. Filterable fields: `users` (email, created_at, updated_at).
